toolboxOwnedFC.normalCase: Registered VCPSleep executed as a native stdio process. Both JSON and SSE follow-ups received the same tool_call_id and native completion text.
toolboxOwnedFC.residentCases: An unframed native proposal and a mixed text proposal + native call were rejected in both transports. Each reached the fixture provider exactly once. An ordinary FC in the same Resident-enabled context executed normally.
toolboxOwnedFC.sseTerminals: Each of the three streams ended with exactly one stop and one [DONE].

tdb.proof: Native watcher and scan indexed a cold-knowledge document. Its distinctive text reached the synthetic provider through [[FixtureKnowledge知识库]].

asynchronousPlugin.scope: Native async ToolBox plugin and authenticated host callback. Audio provider generated synthetic samples.

upgradeRollback.method: The baseline built a new KBM index. After stopping it, the complete index directory was backed up. The candidate opened a copy of that backup and recovered the Aurora diary marker through HTTP. The baseline then opened a separate restored copy and recovered the same marker.
upgradeRollback.sqliteQuickCheck: ok on backup, upgraded copy and restored copy
upgradeRollback.rowHashMethod: SHA256 over UTF-8 Python tuple repr for SELECT * ORDER BY id, in row order.
